name: Market brief, single source, no disagreement

article.title: 2026-08-31 시황 요약
article.no_article_reason: The corpus is one market brief reporting the day's moves. Every claim in it is a restatement of a published series, no source disagrees with another, and no thesis survives that the brief does not already state. Summarising it more briefly is not an article.

frame.thesis: None held. The candidate thesis — that the day's move signals a regime change — is unsupported by a single day's series.
frame.article_worthiness: Not established. A daily brief is a source, not a subject.
frame.audience: Would have been operators tracking rate expectations.
frame.source_weighting: One source, primary for the series it reports and authoritative for nothing else.
verification_needs: Whether the move is outside normal daily variance
frame.original_value_add: None identified. Any framing would restate the brief.
uncertainty: A single day tells us nothing about persistence.
The brief reports the move without a stated cause; attributing one would be our invention.

reviews.notes: NO_ARTICLE 동의. 하루치 브리프는 소스지 주제가 아니다.
